cohort: The study included 13 patients with low-grade gliomas from whom serial serum samples were collected before and after surgery, and 13 healthy women serving as controls, from whom venous cord blood samples were obtained during cesarean section.
finding: Patients with low-grade gliomas exhibited significantly elevated total thiols, native thiols, and disulfide bond formation compared to controls both before and after surgery, indicating a disruption in thiol-disulfide homeostasis that shifts towards an oxidative state.
